findings.issue: Type definition and UNIVERSITY_TABS array still include 'senior' and 'gc' entries
findings.evidence: type UniversityLevel = "freshman" | "remedial" | "senior" | "gc"; and tabs array contains { id: "senior", ... } and { id: "gc", ... }
findings.impact: Super admin users will see Senior and GC tabs that attempt to load data for removed student types, causing failed API calls
findings.fix: Remove 'senior' and 'gc' from UniversityLevel type and remove the two tab entries from UNIVERSITY_TABS array

findings.issue: StudentCategory type includes 'senior' | 'gc' and multiple conditional logic branches check for these values
findings.evidence: type StudentCategory = "remedial" | "freshman" | "senior" | "gc"; with conditions like: activeCategory === "senior" || activeCategory === "gc"
findings.impact: Type safety violation - frontend allows values that backend enum no longer accepts. Legacy data with senior/gc will execute removed logic paths
findings.fix: Change StudentCategory to "remedial" | "freshman" and remove all conditional branches checking for senior/gc
